title: 💰 Affordable Treatment Cost in India
h1: World-Class Medical Care at a Fraction of Global Prices
intro: India is recognized globally for offering high-quality medical treatment at significantly lower costs. International patients can access advanced surgeries, treatments, and therapies at 60–80% less than in the USA, UK, or UAE — without compromising on quality. Our goal is to make healthcare accessible, transparent, and patient-focused, ensuring you receive the best treatment at the most affordable price.

sections.heading: 🏥 Why India Offers Affordable Healthcare
points: No long waiting lists — faster treatment
Cost-effective combination of allopathic & Ayurvedic therapies
Transparent pricing with no hidden charges

sections.heading: 🩺 How We Ensure Affordability
points: Free consultation & cost estimate before arrival
Optional accommodation & transport packages to reduce costs
